==Biography==
=== 2015 Season ===
Mitchell "'''Destiny'''" Shaw first placed in the Oceanic Pro League in [[OPL/2015 Season/Split 1|2015 Split 1]] with [[Rich Gang]]. After the team was [[List of Competitive Rulings|banned from competitive play]], Destiny joined [[Avant Garde]] in April 2015. They placed fourth in the [[OPL/2015 Season/Split 2|second split]] and tied for third in the [[OPL/2015 Season/Split 2 Playoffs|playoffs]].
=== 2016 Season ===
Destiny remained a part of Avant Garde for the 2016 season but switched roles from support to AD carry, with [[Blindturkey]] replacing him as support.
=== 2018 Season ===
Destiny Signed on to the Chiefs Esports Club for the 2018 Season as their Support.

== Trivia ==
* Loves watching anime.
* Early gamertags he used included "DyNaMiC-Mitch" and "ShadowMitch."
* First Australian and Oceania resident to play in the LEC.
